messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Exporting unmarkedEstimateList
parts:
hi Matt,
 When I've done things like this in the past I've used the sink() or dump() commands for this purpose. That will produce a simple print of the list object as it would appear on the screen, and then you have to edit/harvest the stuff you need.
 regards
andy



On Fri, Mar 29, 2013 at 6:11 PM, Matt <matthew.l....@gmail.com> wrote:
I realize this may be a relatively silly question, but I can't figure out how to write the unmarkedEstimateList to a file? It won't convert to a data.frame or other list that is exportable. I tried looking for an answer on the web and in the user manual, but to no avail. My unmarkedEstimateList contains estimates for 113 species, which I produced using the following function  

## Import csv files, 113, one for each species
temp = list.files(pattern="Det*")
for (i in 1:length(temp)) { assign(temp[i], read.csv(temp[i]))
}

##Convert teach detection history to an unmarkedFrameOccu
test.det=sapply(temp,function(x) unmarkedFrameOccu(get(x)))


##Fit models to each of the 113 elements of the list "test.det" from above, with the resulting unmarkedEstimateList having a length of 113 with estimates for Occ and Det.
trash=list(rep(0,113))

for(i in 1:length(temp)){
trash[i]=occu(~1~1,test.det[[i]], method="Nelder-Mead")

#trash.temp[i]=trash@estimates

}


Any advice on how I can get this list of estimates out of R would be very much appreciated.

Cheers,
Matt
